description: Find the product for one barcode: UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, EAN-8, GTIN-14, ISBN-10 or ISBN-13. Returns the title and, where known, brand, category, description, image, price, identifiers and book details. Uses one lookup from the monthly allowance; free when the code is not found.

barcode.description: The barcode, for example 049000050103. Spaces and dashes are ignored.

name: lookup_barcode
title: Look up a barcode
